mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.image_url, a.title, ar.name AS artist_name, ar.country AS artist_country, a.price, a.medium, a.dimensions, a.year, a.description FROM artworks a JOIN artists ar ON a.artist_id = ar.id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.is_active = 1
SELECT t.name FROM artwork_tags at JOIN tags t ON at.tag_id = t.id WHERE at.artwork_id = #{id} ORDER BY t.name ASC
SELECT s.name FROM artwork_sizes arts JOIN sizes s ON arts.size_id = s.id WHERE arts.artwork_id = #{id} AND arts.is_available = 1 ORDER BY s.sort_order ASC, s.id ASC
